RFAA_Lecture_Lab.text: Fleet Academy reciprocal-field lecture lab at Bastion Spire Anchorage — a bright, disciplined Core teaching space combining tiered workstations with a transformable central geometry table, suspended route models, full-scale instrument feeds, and a broad observation window toward active Fleet traffic. Established Fleet visual language: deep navy, ion white, restrained gold, polished stone-metal structure, no mystical ornament. The room is a working technical classroom, not a ceremonial hall.

RFAA_Simulation_Skiff.text: Fleet Academy immersive survey-skiff simulator — a compact four-seat reconstruction of a real Lattice survey cockpit with pilot controls forward, navigation and sensor stations within speaking distance, a small command position behind them, physical tether-spool controls, and wraparound external visualization. During the exercise the simulated ship should read as a credible working survey craft, while subtle Academy interface edges make clear this is a training reconstruction rather than a supernatural transition.

RFAA_Observation_Deck.text: Fleet Academy observation deck at Bastion Spire Anchorage — quiet glass-and-metal overlook after class, facing a verified green corridor line, distant training craft, anchor lights, and normal Core traffic. The point of the setting is contrast: safe space looks ordinary because immense measurement and maintenance effort keeps it ordinary.

RFAA_SIM_EDDY_BOUNDARY.text: Training reconstruction of the surveyed boundary around Calm Eddy Forty-Seven — the verified coherent pocket remains the safe reference behind the crew, while the survey skiff works just outside its charted edge in damaged Lattice space. Sparse anchor beacons and a survey marker float against Warp Black space with stable stars at first glance. The case exists because the eddy boundary has drifted away from its old charted position: danger appears through disagreement among sightline, path length, phase, and anchor relationships. The calm eddy itself should remain visibly and instrumentally coherent; the severe metric behavior occurs beyond its shifted boundary. Avoid psychedelic cloud effects.
